The violin plots display a summary distribution (with median/quartile lines) of log2 enrichment ratios for the striatal IP-MS dataset, but the caption does not state the number or type of biological/technical replicates underlying this dataset.

The panel reports n = 4 with mean ± SD, satisfying the number requirement, but does not state what the 4 replicates represent (e.g., mice, independent IP experiments), so the replicate type is missing.
This panel is a sequence alignment and predicted structural model, not quantitative replicated data, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
